text: A particle P of mass 0.3 kg moves in a circle with centre O on a smooth horizontal surface. P is
attached to O by a light elastic string of modulus of elasticity 12 N and natural length l m. The speed
of P is 4 m s , and the radius of the circle in which it moves is 2l m. Calculate l. [4]
